11 Nights · 12 Days

Heart of the Himalayas

A sacred journey through Nepal, where ancient paths meet the silence of the world's highest mountains.

Explore the Pilgrimage↓

The Call

Some journeys take you somewhere.
Some journeys take you inward.

Beyond the trails, beyond the altitude, beyond the destination lies another kind of journey.

Heart of the Himalayas is an 11-night, 12-day pilgrimage through Nepal — created for those who wish to experience the mountains not simply as scenery, but as sacred presence.

Walk through ancient landscapes, sit in stillness beneath Himalayan skies, encounter living traditions and share moments of devotion, music, meditation and silence.

This is Nepal experienced slowly.

The Doorway

The mountains are not
the destination.

They are the doorway.

The Sacred Trail

A Pilgrimage Map

An ancient trail through the heart of Nepal — not a route to be driven, but a path to be walked.

01Kathmandu
02Pokhara
03Poon Hill
04Jomsom
05Muktinath

Kathmandu → Pokhara → Ghandruk → Tadapani → Ghorepani → Poon Hill → Tatopani → Marpha → Jomsom → Kagbeni → Muktinath → Pokhara

Meet the team

Shoorasena Das

JustPrem creator

Founder of Just Prem Community, Shoorasena is a filmmaker, musician, and yoga teacher who brings creativity and devotion to retreats across India and Nepal.

Instagram

Swami Aniruddha

Guide

A devoted disciple of Paramahamsa Vishwananda, Swami Aniruddha has walked the yogic path for over 20 years. He is known for leading Himalayan pilgrimages, blending yoga, devotion, and community. He inspires seekers to discover the sacred in every step of life.

Instagram

Vanamali Dasi

Pilgrimage organiser

Vanamali Dasi blends art, music, and spirituality through meditation, chanting, yoga, and retreats. A devoted disciple of Paramahamsa Vishwananda, she inspires hearts at spiritual events worldwide.

Instagram

Aika

Team Member

Aika is an inspiring traveler who has explored much of Asia and the East. A devoted kirtan leader, gifted singer and ukulele player, her musical journey began over a decade ago and has become her main life path. As the Community Manager of Just Prem, Aika is the core smile of the team. Her vibrant presence, compassion and dedication inspire those around her.

From the Himalayan Journal

The Question

Why Nepal?

Nepal is more than a landscape.

It is a meeting place of mountains, monasteries, rivers, ancient traditions and living spirituality.

Here, the Himalayas do not simply surround you.
They change the scale of everything.
